facts.fact: The US ITA commercial guide says Tunisie Telecom, the leading international connectivity provider, manages three sub-sea cables, including a Kelibia (Tunisia) to Mazara (Italy) cable; the other two are not named.
facts.system: Kelibia-Mazara cable (three cables managed by Tunisie Telecom)

note: No access fact; Medusa and Bizerte-Marseille link described as upcoming (early 2026).
